_readme: Veille settings. Your own ~/.claude/veille/config.json is deep-merged over this file (mode, coordinator_session, mail, wake, merge...). Change the mode with /veille mode <x>, the pane buttons or `node <bin>/veille/watcher/veille.mjs mode <x>`. Secrets never go here: SMTP credentials live only in ~/.claude/veille/smtp.json (see smtp.example.json).
_launcher: wscript: a hidden VBScript starts node (no console flash). conhost: `conhost.exe --headless`, the fallback when VBScript is disabled.
_actions: alert: write the alert to the pane. notify: Windows notification for every new alert. notify_julian: Windows notification only for alerts that need Julian. mail: e-mail digest for alerts that need Julian. push_claude: a headless `claude -p` that calls PushNotification (off unless push.claude is true; costs tokens). merge: the script merges a green, up-to-date PR/MR itself (gh/glab, no Claude). wake: a fresh `claude -p` (never --resume) with the target conversation's own model, effort and permission mode (read from its session file), in its folder, with a ≤ 10-line brief; output in ~/.claude/veille/wakes, results in the Fil (off unless wake.enabled is true).

rien.label: Rien
rien.help: Veille éteinte : aucun tour, aucune alerte.

légère.label: Légère
légère.help: Un tour toutes les 30 min. Alerte et prévient seulement ; ne merge rien, ne réveille personne, aucun token.

active.label: Active
active.help: Un tour toutes les 5 min. Prévient et réveille la lane ou le coordinateur (si wake.enabled), dans le budget de tokens.

nuit-active.label: Nuit active
nuit-active.help: Un tour toutes les 10 min. Merge les PR/MR vertes et à jour, relance une lane ou un Workflow arrêté (si wake.enabled) ; notifications seulement pour ce qui attend Julian.

nuit-test-légère.label: Nuit test légère
nuit-test-légère.help: Un tour toutes les 30 min. Prévient seulement ; petit budget de tokens pour un éventuel push Claude.

alerts._doc: Rows come from the factory mod's « Ça t'attend » logic (mods/factory/hooks/waiting.mjs, its `waiting` settings apply) plus veille's own: missed (the watcher stopped), workflow (a Workflow agent stopped while its conversation is idle), manual (a GitLab pipeline waits on a manual job: never merged by the veille), exhausted (woken twice without effect), scan (gh / glab unreadable).
alerts._fil: fil_* rows come from the Fil (lib/fil.mjs julianSignal): fil_pending_ask an AskUserQuestion with no answer, fil_wrap a wrap_up with an ask or blocked, fil_needs / fil_awaiting the app's needs_action / interrupted turn, fil_question a conversation at rest whose last message ends on a question to Julian (heuristic), fil_approval a tool call with no result for fil.approval_min while the transcript is silent (probable approval card, not verified), fil_incoherence a session reporting contradicting instructions (keywords in its last message or wrap_up). Every fire (not only tours) announces new ones at once: Windows notification, e-mail when smtp.json exists.

push._claude: true: also run `claude -p --model haiku` asking for a PushNotification (counted in the mode's token budget). Not verified that a -p session reaches the phone: phone pushes need Remote Control connected. The e-mail reaches the phone through its mail app.

wake._enabled: On since 16 Oct: `node veille.mjs wake-test` on throwaway targets (haiku low plan, haiku low acceptEdits, sonnet medium acceptEdits) showed the fresh session ran with exactly the asked model, effort and permission mode (init line and transcript). Wakes still happen only in the modes that list wake (active, nuit-active), within their token budget. false turns them off.
wake._how: Never `claude -p --resume` (16 Oct 22:45: it turned effort low into medium and acceptEdits into bypass). A fresh session: claude -p --model/--effort/--permission-mode from the target's session file (sessions_dir, default the app folder found by lib/core/sessions.mjs appDir: %LOCALAPPDATA%/Claude-Data/<profile>/claude-code-sessions since 19 Oct, else %APPDATA%/Claude/claude-code-sessions), cwd = its folder, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL = its model, stream-json log in ~/.claude/veille/wakes. Each fire reads the result and checks the model, effort and permission mode the session really ran with (its transcript); a gap is a wake_failed (health -> Problèmes). Missing or unknown settings: no wake. Test: node veille.mjs wake-test.
wake._target: coordinator: always the conversation registered with /veille coordinateur. owner: the conversation that owns the row, else the coordinator.

fil._doc: The Fil (/veille fil): every conversation's last message, grouped by project, lead → sub-conversations, written by the watcher to ~/.claude/veille/fil.json at every fire and tour (files only, zero model tokens). The pane reads that file and refreshes only on « Rafraîchir ». projects: [] = all, else project names. per_project: most recent conversations per project (those waiting on Julian are never cut). preview_chars: collapsed preview. full_chars: expanded message. archived: non | aujourdhui | oui. live_s: transcript written this recently = en cours. approval_min: probable approval card after this many silent minutes.

labels.title: Fil des conversations
labels.open_note: ouverture par le lien claude:// de l’app : non vérifiée
labels.missing: fil.json absent : « Rafraîchir » le construit (ou la tâche ClaudeVeille au prochain passage).

archive._doc: « À archiver » (its own tab of the Veille pane, /veille archiver): at every fire the watcher writes ~/.claude/veille/archive.json with the finished conversations the VEILLE conversation may archive in one batch (archive_session). The script never archives. A candidate: open (not archived), no activity for idle_h hours (session file, transcript, sub-agent and workflow files), no pending tool call, every PR of the session merged or closed (or none). Never a candidate: pinned (isStarred) or autoArchiveExempt, waiting on Julian (the Fil's signals, needs_action, interrupted), a status in keep_status, the newest open conversation of its project (keep_newest_per_project), a title matching role_pattern (regex; default: upper-case name then a number, « VEILLE 1 »).

labels.title: À archiver ({n})
labels.note: La conversation VEILLE les archive en un lot (archive_session) ; le script n’archive jamais.
labels.missing: archive.json absent : la tâche ClaudeVeille l’écrit au prochain passage.

export._doc: « Export eta » tab (/veille export, and /export-eta when the export-eta mod is not loaded): export-eta's batch of finished conversations, read from ~/.claude/export-eta/pending.json and state.json (EXPORT_ETA_HOME moves it). « Exporter vers eta » runs export-eta's exporter (export-eta/exporter/export.mjs run --mode batch, beside veille), « Rafraîchir » its pending command; nothing else is pushed. batch_min: the threshold shown when pending.json has none (export-eta's own setting decides). history: last exports shown. labels override lib/export-view.mjs EXPORT_LABELS.

night._doc: /veille nuit: mode `mode` from now (night_started in ~/.claude/veille/config.json). /veille jour: mode `day_mode` and the night summary (merges, failures, what waited on Julian, wakes since nuit started, else the last fallback_h hours) in ~/.claude/veille/night-summary.json, shown in the Alertes tab for show_h hours.

deadlines._doc: Alerts J-7 and J-1 (days) for open lines `- [ ] YYYY-MM-DD · prio · quoi · ...` of file (the « À toi · Claude Control » list). One alert per stage, so J-1 notifies again; overdue items stay at J-1.
deadlines.title: À toi · Claude Control

vendor_check._doc: Every every_days, the latest upstream release (gh api repos/<repo>/releases/latest, read only) vs the vendored copy's plugin.json version (in the repo checkout recorded by veille install). A newer release is an info alert until the copy is updated.

problemes._doc: Each tour also runs the problemes mod's collector (mods/problemes/scanner/problemes_scan.mjs collect, zero tokens) when its files are in the installed copy. enabled: false turns it off.
